name: ui-lib-design-system
description: A React + SCSS component library with 17 components, semantic tokens, light/dark themes, and 8 product brand scopes. When installed, Claude Code sessions in any repo can import from @ui/lib and use these components/tokens when generating UIs.

skills.name: ui-lib-usage
skills.description: Load this when the user wants to build UI in a project that has @ui/lib installed. Sets Claude up to import from @ui/lib and follow its conventions (BEM classes, tokens, forwardRef, no third-party UI libs).

resources.name: component-reference
resources.description: Full component API reference — every export, props, and usage examples.

resources.name: token-reference
resources.description: Complete token vocabulary — spacing, typography, colors, shadows, motion.

resources.name: conventions
resources.description: Non-negotiable rules for extending or modifying the library.
